files.auction_terms.md:
# Porthilly Fish Quay - auction terms, 2026 season

The quay levies 2.4 per cent of the sale value of a landing to cover the auction floor, the ice plant and the
quay dues.

A landing recorded as a charity sale is not charged the levy: the catch is auctioned for the food bank and the
quay waives its charge.
files.README.md:
# Porthilly Fish Quay - landing records, August 2026

One row per landing sold across the quay; value is the total the boxes made at auction.
